review.posthog_relevance: Adds frontend state and API parameters for heatmap date-range and timestamp overrides, including history view and screenshot status, though backend HogQL application and complete response handling are not shown.
review.reason: Adds TypeScript interfaces and state properties for heatmap date-range and history view, and backend API parameters for timestamp bounds. While the implementation of the HogQL query application and complete backend response handling is not shown, the observed changes establish the necessary frontend and API contract for this feature. This is a substantive, bounded capability change
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation of the backend HogQL query application and complete response handling, preventing a definitive assessment of whether the implementation is complete and correct. The tier is assigned based on the visible API and state changes, not the complete end-to-end behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the new date-range override behavior.
